title: 9-Ball Mississippi Fishing Charters

services.name: Our Charters
services.desc: We use only the finest rods and reels money can buy. Whether you are on vacation or playing hooky from work, our charter service is committed to showing you the best time. We do any kind of fishing: cobia , red snapper , trout , king mackerel , redfish , and our most popular: shark! Capt. Barry was born and raised in Gulfport, Mississippi and began fishing the Mississippi Gulf Coast when he was 10, catching redfish and shark. At 16, Barry started working as a deck hand on the charter boat, ‘Sand Dollar’ fishing the Gulf waters under Capt. Jim Mowrey, until his retirement from Mississippi Charter fishing.
